Hi Sophie — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum on the procurement and billing side: 

Summary of what we covered:
- Goal: Pilot Redwood inference for Acme Analytics' customer-facing summarization pipeline (initial 3-month pilot).
- Usage estimate: ~200k tokens/day peak; expect monthly invoice ~$12k depending on model/throughput.
- Technical: Connor will share SOW draft + scoped deliverables; we'll provide trial keys for the pilot when PO or billing is in place.

Action items / asks from Acme for procurement & billing qualification:
1) Confirm whether Acme will purchase via PO (preferred for your procurement) or corporate card.
2) If PO: confirm billing address, legal entity name, and whether net-30 terms are acceptable.
3) Any specific invoice format or line-item breakdown required by AP (e.g., separate hosting vs usage lines, tax/VAT treatment).
4) Tax details: if you require a W-9 or VAT ID, let us know the exact fields.
5) Marketplace interest: are you planning to buy through AWS Marketplace or direct invoice? We can support both but the commercial path/contract differs.

Attached: Redwood-Invoice-Template.xlsx (sample invoice format), SOW-draft.docx (initial scope).

If you can reply with procurement contact and preferred billing flow, I will: (a) confirm we can accept PO + net-30, (b) provide required vendor paperwork (W-9/EIN) and Redwood billing address, and (c) loop in Connor for the SOW review.

Thanks — looking forward to the next steps.

Hi Marissa — thanks for the recap and for sending the SOW. Quick answers from our side: 

- Procurement path: We will most likely use a PO and net-30 terms. Our procurement team requires a PO for any vendor engagement > $10k.
- Billing info: Our AP needs invoices addressed to:
  Acme Analytics, Inc.
  123 Innovation Way
  Suite 400
  San Francisco, CA 94105

- Required invoice fields: line-item breakdown (service description, quantity, unit price, total), our PO number (to be added to the invoice once PO is issued), and vendor EIN/TIN.
- Tax/VAT: We are US-based — no VAT for domestic vendors, but please include your EIN on the invoice.
- Paperwork: Procurement requests your W-9 and vendor registration link.
- Marketplace: We'd prefer direct invoice for initial pilot but keep marketplace option open for later.

Looping in procurement and AP on this thread.
